notes.title: UP TO 4 PLAYERS CO-OP MULTIPLAYER UPDATE
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=fSoVJxcBbYg;full][/previewyoutube]

We have recently made a ton of improvements to Operation Serpens: 

- 3 new difficulty levels for the single user campaign story.
- Free locomotion and teleportation movement.
- Flying an assault drones.
- A crazy fun new co-op multiplayer up to 4 players.

Please give it a try, we hope you like it.
